(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 1: MASTER SAFETY CIRCUIT, HARDWARE INTERLOCKS & FAULT RESET SUPERVISION
====================================================================================================
*)
fbTrigReset(CLK := bResetFault);
fbToneEStopDebounce(IN := NOT bEmergencyStopOk, PT := T#20MS);

(* Operator Manual Reset Evaluation *)
IF fbTrigReset.Q THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := 16#00000000;
    dwFaultActive_Warning := 16#00000000;
    bAlarmActive := FALSE;
    IF iState = 130 THEN
        iState := 0; (* Return from Emergency Abort to Cold Safe State *)
        bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Category 4 / SIL 3 Emergency Stop Trip Interlock *)
IF fbToneEStopDebounce.Q THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Emergency Stop Asserted *)
    bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
    bDepositionActive := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    rTMA_DosingValve_pct := 0.0;
    rH2O_DosingValve_pct := 0.0;
    rBearingBleedValve_pct := 0.0; (* Close bleed to maintain maximum levitation cushion *)
    iState := 130; (* Force Transition to State 130: Emergency Shutdown & Blanket Scrub *)
END_IF;

(* Glovebox / Enclosure Perimeter Door Seal Interlock *)
IF NOT bSafetyDoorInterlock THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Safety Enclosure Breach *)
    IF iState >= 40 THEN
        iState := 130;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Precursor Exhaust Scrubber / Thermal Oxidizer Vacuum Draft Interlock *)
IF NOT bPrecursorExhaustDraftOk THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Exhaust Draft Vacuum Failure *)
    IF iState >= 80 THEN
        iState := 130;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Pyrophoric TMA Toxic Gas Leak Detection Interlock *)
IF NOT bTMA_GasLeakDetectorOk THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000008; (* Bit 3: TMA Ambient Gas Leak Detected *)
    bEmergencyVentActive := TRUE;
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(* High-Purity Nitrogen Bulk Supply Pressure Interlock *)
IF NOT bN2_BulkSupplyPressureOk THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000010; (* Bit 4: Bulk N2 Supply Depleted *)
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) SENSOR VOTING & FAULT TOLERANCE
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 2.1 Micro-Gap Sensor Triplet Slew-Rate and Boundary Plausibility Checks --- *)
IF (rGapSensor1_um < 5.0) OR (rGapSensor1_um > 95.0) OR (ABS(rGapSensor1_um - rGap_Prev_S1) > (rGap_SlewRateLimit_um_s * rTs)) THEN
    bGap_S1_Valid := FALSE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister OR 16#00000001; (* Bit 0: Gap Sensor 1 Unhealthy *)
ELSE
    bGap_S1_Valid := TRUE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister AND 16#FFFFFFFE;
END_IF;
rGap_Prev_S1 := rGapSensor1_um;

IF (rGapSensor2_um < 5.0) OR (rGapSensor2_um > 95.0) OR (ABS(rGapSensor2_um - rGap_Prev_S2) > (rGap_SlewRateLimit_um_s * rTs)) THEN
    bGap_S2_Valid := FALSE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister OR 16#00000002; (* Bit 1: Gap Sensor 2 Unhealthy *)
ELSE
    bGap_S2_Valid := TRUE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister AND 16#FFFFFFFD;
END_IF;
rGap_Prev_S2 := rGapSensor2_um;

IF (rGapSensor3_um < 5.0) OR (rGapSensor3_um > 95.0) OR (ABS(rGapSensor3_um - rGap_Prev_S3) > (rGap_SlewRateLimit_um_s * rTs)) THEN
    bGap_S3_Valid := FALSE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister OR 16#00000004; (* Bit 2: Gap Sensor 3 Unhealthy *)
ELSE
    bGap_S3_Valid := TRUE;
    dwDegradedStateRegister := dwDegradedStateRegister AND 16#FFFFFFFB;
END_IF;
rGap_Prev_S3 := rGapSensor3_um;

(* --- 2.2 Discrepancy Matrix Evaluation Across Triplet --- *)
rGap_Discrepancy_12 := ABS(rGapSensor1_um - rGapSensor2_um);
rGap_Discrepancy_23 := ABS(rGapSensor2_um - rGapSensor3_um);
rGap_Discrepancy_13 := ABS(rGapSensor1_um - rGapSensor3_um);

fbToneDiscrepancyGap(IN := ((rGap_Discrepancy_12 > rGap_DiscrepancyTol_um) AND (rGap_Discrepancy_23 > rGap_DiscrepancyTol_um) AND (rGap_Discrepancy_13 > rGap_DiscrepancyTol_um)), PT := T#250MS);
IF fbToneDiscrepancyGap.Q THEN
    dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000001; (* Warning Bit 0: Persistent Gap Triplet Discrepancy *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 2oo3 Voting & Graceful Degradation Logic --- *)
IF bGap_S1_Valid AND bGap_S2_Valid AND bGap_S3_Valid THEN
    (* Full 2oo3 Mode: Median Selection Algorithm *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 3;
    bDegradedModeActive := FALSE;
    IF ((rGapSensor1_um >= rGapSensor2_um) AND (rGapSensor1_um <= rGapSensor3_um)) OR ((rGapSensor1_um >= rGapSensor3_um) AND (rGapSensor1_um <= rGapSensor2_um)) THEN
        rGapVoted_um := rGapSensor1_um;
    ELSIF ((rGapSensor2_um >= rGapSensor1_um) AND (rGapSensor2_um <= rGapSensor3_um)) OR ((rGapSensor2_um >= rGapSensor3_um) AND (rGapSensor2_um <= rGapSensor1_um)) THEN
        rGapVoted_um := rGapSensor2_um;
    ELSE
        rGapVoted_um := rGapSensor3_um;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bGap_S1_Valid AND bGap_S2_Valid AND (NOT bGap_S3_Valid) THEN
    (* Single Channel S3 Failure: 1oo2 Degraded Mode Averaging *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rGapVoted_um := 0.5 * (rGapSensor1_um + rGapSensor2_um);
ELSIF bGap_S1_Valid AND (NOT bGap_S2_Valid) AND bGap_S3_Valid THEN
    (* Single Channel S2 Failure: 1oo2 Degraded Mode Averaging *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rGapVoted_um := 0.5 * (rGapSensor1_um + rGapSensor3_um);
ELSIF (NOT bGap_S1_Valid) AND bGap_S2_Valid AND bGap_S3_Valid THEN
    (* Single Channel S1 Failure: 1oo2 Degraded Mode Averaging *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 2;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    rGapVoted_um := 0.5 * (rGapSensor2_um + rGapSensor3_um);
ELSE
    (* Multiple Sensor Failure (Double or Triple Fault): Fail-Safe Trip *)
    iGap_FailoverMode := 1;
    bDegradedModeActive := TRUE;
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000020; (* Bit 5: Dual Gap Sensor Failure *)
    rGapVoted_um := 0.0; (* Force zero to indicate collapse hazard *)
    IF iState >= 40 THEN
        iState := 130;
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rEstimatedMicroGap_um := rGapVoted_um;

(* Catastrophic Gap Crash Hazard Interlock *)
IF (rEstimatedMicroGap_um < 14.0) AND (iState >= 40) THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000040; (* Bit 6: Micro-Gap Collapse Hazard (< 14 um) *)
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 3: KNUDSEN SLIP CORRECTION, PÉCLET PURGE DYNAMICS & IN-SITU QCM MASS RECKONER
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 3.1 Gas Bearing Viscosity & Knudsen Number Calculation --- *)
rTempAbs_K := rReactorTemperature_degC + 273.15;
(* Sutherland equation for dynamic viscosity of nitrogen gas *)
rN2_DynamicViscosity := rViscosity_N2_Base * ((rTempAbs_K / 273.15)**1.5) * ((273.15 + rSutherland_S) / (rTempAbs_K + rSutherland_S));

(* Mean free path calculation: lambda = (k_B * T) / (sqrt(2) * pi * d^2 * p) *)
rMeanFreePath_m := (rBoltzmann_kB * rTempAbs_K) / (1.41421356 * rPI * (rMoleculeDiameter_N2 * rMoleculeDiameter_N2) * (rExhaustPressure_mbar * 100.0));
IF rEstimatedMicroGap_um > 1.0 THEN
    rKnudsenNumber := (rMeanFreePath_m * 1.0E6) / rEstimatedMicroGap_um;
ELSE
    rKnudsenNumber := 0.005;
END_IF;
rKnudsenSlipCorrection := 1.0 + (6.0 * rKnudsenNumber);

(* --- 3.2 Dynamic Inter-Slit N2 Purge Curtain Péclet Number Reckoner --- *)
(* Convert flow from sccm to m^3/s at operating conditions *)
rGasFlow_m3_s := (rN2PurgeFlow_sccm * 1.66667E-8) * (rTempAbs_K / 273.15) * (1013.25 / MAX(rExhaustPressure_mbar, 100.0));
rGasVelocity_m_s := rGasFlow_m3_s / (rPurgeSlitArea_mm2 * 1.0E-6);
rDiffCoeff_Actual := rDiffCoeff_TMA_N2_Ref * ((rTempAbs_K / 393.15)**1.75) * (1013.25 / MAX(rExhaustPressure_mbar, 100.0));
rCurrentPecletNumber := (rGasVelocity_m_s * (rBarrierLandWidth_mm * 1.0E-3)) / MAX(rDiffCoeff_Actual, 1.0E-9);

(* Péclet Number Isolation Warning *)
IF (rCurrentPecletNumber < 95.0) AND (iState >= 80) THEN
    dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000002; (* Warning Bit 1: Purge Péclet Number Deficient (< 95) *)
END_IF;

(* Precursor Differential Pressure Cross-Contamination Trip *)
IF ((ABS(rDeltaP_TMA_mbar) > 0.12) OR (ABS(rDeltaP_H2O_mbar) > 0.12)) AND (iState >= 90) THEN
    dwFaultLatched_Critical := dwFaultLatched_Critical OR 16#00000080; (* Bit 7: Precursor Differential Overpressure (> 0.12 mbar) *)
    iState := 130;
END_IF;

(* --- 3.3 In-Situ Quartz Crystal Microbalance (QCM) Mass & Growth Reckoner --- *)
(* Update QCM 16-element ring buffer for noise suppression *)
aQCM_FreqBuffer[iQCM_BufferIdx] := rQCM_RawFrequency_Hz;
iQCM_BufferIdx := (iQCM_BufferIdx + 1) MOD 16;
rSumTemp := 0.0;
FOR iIdx := 0 TO 15 DO
    rSumTemp := rSumTemp + aQCM_FreqBuffer[iIdx];
END_FOR;
rQCM_FreqFiltered := rSumTemp / 16.0;

(* 4th-order polynomial thermal drift compensation for AT-cut quartz *)
rSumTemp := rQCM_CrystalTemp_degC - rQCM_ReferenceTemp;
rDeltaLambda := (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c1 * rSumTemp) + (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c2 * (rSumTemp**2)) + (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c3 * (rSumTemp**3)) + (rQCM_PolyCoeff_c4 * (rSumTemp**4));
rSumTemp := (rQCM_BaselineFreq - rQCM_FreqFiltered) - rDeltaLambda; (* Temperature-corrected frequency delta [Hz] *)

(* Sauerbrey mass reckoning with Lu-Lewis acoustic Z-match correction *)
IF rSumTemp > 0.0 THEN
    (* Dimensionless acoustic impedance ratio Z_factor = Z_quartz / Z_Al2O3 *)
    rMaxLambdaDiff := rQCM_AcousticImpedance_Quartz / rQCM_AcousticImpedance_Al2O3;
    rDeltaLambda := (rPI * rSumTemp) / rQCM_FreqNominal;
    rQCM_AccumulatedMass_ug_cm2 := (rQCM_AcousticImpedance_Quartz / (rPI * rMaxLambdaDiff)) * ATAN(rMaxLambdaDiff * TAN(rDeltaLambda)) * 1.0E6;
    rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm := (rQCM_AccumulatedMass_ug_cm2 * 1.0E-2) / rDensity_Al2O3;
ELSE
    rQCM_AccumulatedMass_ug_cm2 := 0.0;
    rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic Growth-Per-Cycle (GPC) Estimation *)
IF (rWebVelocity_m_min > 0.5) AND (iState = 100) THEN
    (* Calculate active spatial deposition cycle frequency: f_cycle = v_web / L_module *)
    rQCM_CyclesCount := rQCM_CyclesCount + ((rWebVelocity_m_min / 60.0) / 0.50) * rTs; (* 0.50 m per module length *)
    IF rQCM_CyclesCount >= 1.0 THEN
        rThicknessDelta_nm := rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm - rQCM_LastCycleThickness_nm;
        IF rThicknessDelta_nm > 0.0 THEN
            rGrowthRate_A_per_cycle := (rThicknessDelta_nm * 10.0) / rQCM_CyclesCount; (* 1 nm = 10 Angstrom *)
        END_IF;
        rQCM_LastCycleThickness_nm := rAccumulatedFilmThickness_nm;
        rQCM_CyclesCount := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* QCM Crystal Health & Motional Damping Impedance Check *)
IF rQCM_DampingResistance_Ohm < rQCM_MotionalResistMax THEN
    rQCM_CrystalHealth_pct := 100.0 * (1.0 - (rQCM_DampingResistance_Ohm / rQCM_MotionalResistMax));
ELSE
    rQCM_CrystalHealth_pct := 0.0;
    dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000004; (* Warning Bit 2: QCM Crystal Saturated / Damping Critical *)
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
 SECTION 4: WEB LATERAL WANDER OPTICAL SERVO & SHELTON BEAM MECHANICS
====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 4.1 Euler-Eytelwein Tension Decoupling Filter --- *)
rFilteredWebTension := (0.92 * rFilteredWebTension) + (0.08 * rWebTension_N);
rCalculatedWebTension_N := rFilteredWebTension;

(* --- 4.2 Lateral Tracking Error Residual & Deadband Handling --- *)
rLateralWebTrackingError_mm := rWebEdgePos_mm - rWebEdgeSetpoint_mm;
IF ABS(rLateralWebTrackingError_mm) < rSteer_Deadband_mm THEN
    rSumTemp := 0.0; (* Inside sensor noise deadband *)
ELSE
    rSumTemp := rLateralWebTrackingError_mm;
END_IF;

(* --- 4.3 Digital Lead-Lag Compensator with Anti-Windup Integration --- *)
IF (iState >= 70) AND (iState <= 110) THEN
    (* Trapezoidal integration with conditional clamping *)
    rSteer_IntegralSum := rSteer_IntegralSum + ((rSteer_Kp / rSteer_Ti) * rSumTemp * rTs);
    IF rSteer_IntegralSum > 8.0 THEN
        rSteer_IntegralSum := 8.0;
    ELSIF rSteer_IntegralSum < -8.0 THEN
        rSteer_IntegralSum := -8.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Derivative lead calculation on error *)
    rDeltaLambda := (rSumTemp - rSteer_LeadLag_State1) / rTs;
    rSteer_LeadLag_State1 := rSumTemp;

    (* Total raw steering command: PID + Tension feedforward *)
    rMaxLambdaDiff := (rSteer_Kp * rSumTemp) + rSteer_IntegralSum + (rSteer_Td * rDeltaLambda) + (rTension_Feedforward_Gain * (rTargetWebTension_N - rFilteredWebTension));

    (* Slew rate limiter: |dr/dt| <= rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s *)
    rDeltaLambda := rMaxLambdaDiff - rEdgeGuideServo_mm;
    IF rDeltaLambda > (rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs) THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rEdgeGuideServo_mm + (rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs);
    ELSIF rDeltaLambda < -(rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs) THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rEdgeGuideServo_mm - (rSteer_SlewMax_mm_s * rTs);
    ELSE
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rMaxLambdaDiff;
    END_IF;

    (* Hardware stroke limits *)
    IF rEdgeGuideServo_mm > rSteer_MaxStroke_mm THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := rSteer_MaxStroke_mm;
        dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000008; (* Warning Bit 3: Steering Guide Near Positive Stroke Limit *)
    ELSIF rEdgeGuideServo_mm < -rSteer_MaxStroke_mm THEN
        rEdgeGuideServo_mm := -rSteer_MaxStroke_mm;
        dwFaultActive_Warning := dwFaultActive_Warning OR 16#00000010; (* Warning Bit 4: Steering Guide Near Negative Stroke Limit *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Servo disengaged: Return to neutral mechanical zero *)
    rEdgeGuideServo_mm := 0.0;
    rSteer_IntegralSum := 0.0;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================

====================================================================================================
*)
(* --- 5.1 System Matrices Population (Executed Once on Startup or Auto-Tune) --- *)
fbTrigAutoTune(CLK := bAutoTuneRequest);
IF (NOT bMatricesInitialized) OR fbTrigAutoTune.Q THEN
    (* Clear A_Sys, B_Sys, C_Sys, D_Sys *)
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            A_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            B_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;
    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 8 DO
            C_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
        FOR jIdx := 1 TO 4 DO
            D_Sys[iIdx, jIdx] := 0.0;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Discrete Matrix A_Sys (8x8) at Ts = 0.005s *)
    A_Sys[1, 1] := 0.965;  A_Sys[1, 2] := 0.0048; A_Sys[1, 3] := -0.012; A_Sys[1, 4] := -0.011;
    A_Sys[2, 1] := -1.25;  A_Sys[2, 2] := 0.880;  A_Sys[2, 3] := -0.450; A_Sys[2, 4] := -0.420;
    A_Sys[3, 3] := 0.910;  A_Sys[3, 4] := 0.025;
    A_Sys[4, 3] := 0.022;  A_Sys[4, 4] := 0.915;
    A_Sys[5, 5] := 0.985;  A_Sys[5, 6] := 0.0049;
    A_Sys[6, 5] := -0.85;  A_Sys[6, 6] := 0.920;
    A_Sys[7, 7] := 1.000;  (* Pure integrator for accumulated film thickness *)
    A_Sys[8, 8] := 0.992;  (* Thermal platen slow dynamic decay *)

    (* Discrete Matrix B_Sys (8x4) *)
    B_Sys[1, 1] := -0.085; B_Sys[1, 2] := 0.0012; B_Sys[1, 3] := 0.0005; B_Sys[1, 4] := 0.0;
    B_Sys[2, 1] := -3.450; B_Sys[2, 2] := 0.0450; B_Sys[2, 3] := 0.0150; B_Sys[2, 4] := 0.0;
    B_Sys[3, 1] := 0.015;  B_Sys[3, 2] := 0.0035; B_Sys[3, 3] := -0.008; B_Sys[3, 4] := 0.0;
    B_Sys[4, 1] := 0.014;  B_Sys[4, 2] := 0.0036; B_Sys[4, 3] := 0.0005; B_Sys[4, 4] := -0.007;
    B_Sys[5, 1] := 0.0;    B_Sys[5, 2] := 0.0;    B_Sys[5, 3] := 0.0;    B_Sys[5, 4] := 0.052;

    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 20 DO

                InvHessian[iIdx, jIdx] := -0.05 * Hessian_H[iIdx, jIdx] / (MAX(Hessian_H[iIdx, iIdx], 0.001) * MAX(Hessian_H[jIdx, jIdx], 0.001));

    FOR iIdx := 1 TO 24 DO

    END_FOR;

(* --- 5.2 Plant Output Residual & State Observer Propagation --- *)
